recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No current core source correction is needed for FHIR-13731; any future changes should be ordinary terminology/example maintenance rather than reconciliation for this tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-13731 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Pharmacy change request asking that MedicationDispense examples stop emitting UCUM warnings for codes such as TAB, RECSUPP, gm, and patch. The application comment says Medication, MedicationAdministration, and MedicationDispense were fixed by either changing to the drug-form code system or correcting the UCUM unit.

Later terminology maintenance updated the v3 orderable drug-form canonical to http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-orderableDrugForm, preserving the intended separation between drug-form codes and UCUM units. Community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. A current active-source scan found zero occurrences of TAB, RECSUPP, gm, or patch coded under http://unitsofmeasure.org in Medication, MedicationAdministration, or MedicationDispense examples.
